snippet.title: Jambo! Safari - Trailer #1
snippet.description:
ESRB Rating: RATING PENDING. Visit www.esrb.org for rating information.

The first of our Jambo! Safari trailers is here! Relive the arcade experience - and then some - as you Explore, Rescue, Heal, and Photograph - and get some Ostrich racing in on the side.
